  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "The nature/characterisation of incidents worth attention -- what kind of problem each incident is and whether it exhibits attention-worthy patterns (recurrence, cross-assignment, self-resolution)",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "incident_category", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Classifies the incident domain (database, email, vpn, etc.), a core facet of characterising what an incident is about."},
    {"name": "problem_nature", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Captures the type of failure (outage, access_denied, crash), directly describing what is worth attention about the incident."},
    {"name": "affected_system_type", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Identifies what class of system is impacted, a coherent facet of incident characterisation."},
    {"name": "self_resolved", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Flags whether the incident resolved itself, a meaningful attention signal distinguishing noise from real issues."},
    {"name": "cross_assignment", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Indicates handoff/reassignment, a process-friction signal relevant to what warrants attention."},
    {"name": "recurrent_caller", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "This is a bare caller name enumeration; labelled 'recurrent' but values are just top callers, drifting toward a caller-directory attribute rather than an incident-attention facet."},
    {"name": "opened_hour_of_day", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "A near-uniform temporal extraction with no discriminating signal; a generic time-derived feature not centred on incident attention-worthiness."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.72,
  "structure_quality": 0.68,
  "focus_actionability": 0.75,
  "rationale": "The majority of columns (category, problem_nature, affected_system_type, self_resolved, cross_assignment) cohere well around a single inferable focus: characterising incidents to surface what merits attention. This gives a sound multi-facet structure spanning what/where/how-handled at a useful granularity, and the focus is genuinely actionable (an analyst can triage by problem type, spot self-resolving noise, and flag cross-assignment friction). However, coherence is diluted by two weaker additions: recurrent_caller collapses to a bare caller enumeration (an attribute more about people than incident nature), and opened_hour_of_day is a near-uniform, low-information temporal extraction that adds noise rather than an attention signal. These prevent top marks but do not make the set a scattered grab-bag; the centre of gravity remains a coherent, investigable incident-attention focus."
}
